A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
BSc can be used as a general framework for assessing the interrelationships between non-financial performance measures and financial performance.
the BSc model can be used for assessing the interrelations between non-financial measures and financial performance, even if the companies do not actually apply BSc.
the improvement of non-financial performance parameters can contribute to an increase of the financial performance of companies.
